rationale: ROUND 2 of the feature-builder delta-2 review. Round 1 (5a65ec4c) returned REVISE: edit-quality/bug_historian/reuse_agent/tooling_provenance/guardian objected, one HIGH severity. This round answers every objection; two are answered by real changes already committed and applied, not by argument. This code is COMMITTED AND LIVE in the running chassis v1.0.1144 (pod agent-chassis-59c675c4f-pxr9f greps feature_stage_route=3, formatGeneratedGo=2, tolerate_truncation=1) — so the sketches below are the committed bytes, not a proposal. STANDING EVIDENCE (restated in full, seats have no cross-round memory): the stage loop turns a council-APPROVED staged plan into one feat/<short-corr> branch with one commit + build gate per stage and a derived go-test end gate (D6), then ONE PR; it reuses the proven read/prepare/build-gate actions by emitting each stage AS a single-plan shape, so those actions loop without knowing they loop; every new field is opt-in and UNSET by the existing fix-implementer caller, so the single-plan path is byte-identical (fix loop untouched); E1-E5 were owner-approved 2026-07-17 (DESIGN_stage_loop_delta2.md §3). Blast radius verified live 2026-07-18: ONLY fix-implementer and feature-implementer invoke these three shared actions (no third pipeline); all buildGateScript call sites (3 test + 1 production + the definition) are accounted for; feature-implementer IS in the running pod binary (pod-grep). ANSWERS, each checked not argued: (1) editquality [registry.go buried in edit-1's sketch]: FIXED — registry.go is now its own declared edit (edit 2 below, real hunk at registry.go:1219). (2) editquality+guardian [expected_symbols verbatim-substring gate can false-reject a stage whose symbol is defined in an EARLIER stage's file]: FIXED AT THE SOURCE, not by weakening the gate — feature-designer PATCH_018 (edit 7, config_change, applied live + snapshot ba8f1fcd) tightens the design prompt's rule 8 to 'list ONLY symbols this stage's OWN edited files INTRODUCE; never a symbol your stage merely CALLS that is defined in an earlier stage's file; a wiring-only stage uses an empty expected_symbols list'. The deterministic missingExpectedSymbols check stays intact. (3) bug_historian [HIGH] + guardian [the three resolve-non-empty-or-fall-back seams are the platform's worst-known failure shape]: FIXED — commit 9c94cc842. ref_field, branch_field, commit_message_field and test_packages_field now FAIL LOUD when configured-but-resolved-empty (each returns an explicit error refusing the silent fallback); UNSET keeps the single-plan path unchanged. Edits 3/4/5 below show the committed hard-error code. This was the round's one high-severity find and it is closed. (4) reuse_agent [should site_work_items sequencing (parent_item_id/depends_on/batch_id) carry stage state instead of a new action?]: considered and rejected, here is the why. site_work_items sequencing is for QUEUEING independent work items across SEPARATE dispatches — each row is claimed by its own orchestration, on its own schedule, with no shared in-memory state. feature_stage_route carries IN-RUN workflow state inside ONE orchestration's collected_data (current stage index, the plan parsed once, the branch name, the per-stage read ref) so later stages commit onto the same branch and see earlier stages' commits — state that must not survive the run, must not be independently claimable, and must advance deterministically within a single execution. That is exactly the diagnosis loop's diagnose_route precedent (in-run iteration in collected_data), not the work-item table's job. Registry search for an existing generic 'stage advance' / 'loop controller' action: none — the diagnosis loop's iteration is inline control flow, not a reusable action, so feature_stage_route is genuinely the only new control machinery, and it is small, deterministic and unit-tested. (5) tooling_provenance [the three shared actions should carry travelling PLAN+NOTES, subject_type='action']: DONE — migration 184 (applied live, ledger recorded) adds 'action' to the doc_plans/doc_notes subject_type CHECK (the convention the seat cited had NO schema support — zero action rows existed, the constraint allowed only tool/pipeline/experience) and seats a PLAN + a NOTES for diagnose_read_repo_files, diagnose_prepare_fix_commit and diagnose_build_gate, each recording the shared consumers, the delta-2 seam and the fail-loud invariant. The isRepoCloningAgent list entry is likewise noted. (6) editquality [E4 embeds a GitHub branches-API call — reimplementation?]: no reimplementation. Branch CREATION stays on the git-adapter's create_branch verb (git_adapter_request), reused unchanged, once before the loop. feature_stage_route's direct call is a READ-ONLY existence GET (githubBranchExists, line 375) for the E4 stale-branch refusal — the git-adapter exposes create/commit/PR verbs but no 'does branch X exist' query, and this read writes nothing, so the write cage is intact.

plan.summary: Feature-builder delta 2: the implementer stage-loop machinery — one new deterministic loop-controller action (feature_stage_route) plus opt-in field seams on three shared fix-loop actions and one spawn-gate list entry — reviewed round 2 with all round-1 objections answered. The HIGH-severity silent-fallback class is fixed fail-loud (9c94cc842); expected_symbols false-reject is mitigated at the designer source (PATCH_018); registry registration is its own edit; the three shared actions now carry travelling PLAN+NOTES (migration 184). Every new field is UNSET by the existing fix-implementer caller, so the single-plan path is byte-identical.

edits.rationale: The loop's only new control machinery: a deterministic (no model judgement) stage-loop controller mirroring the diagnosis loop's iteration. It keeps IN-RUN state in collected_data (current stage index, the plan parsed once, branch, base ref) and emits each stage AS a single-plan shape so the proven read/prepare/build-gate actions loop unchanged. In-run workflow state, NOT cross-dispatch work-item queueing (reuse_agent answer): the state must not survive the run, must not be independently claimable, and advances deterministically within one orchestration — the diagnose_route precedent.

Round-1 editquality: the registration is load-bearing (CLAUDE.md: 'a seed naming an unregistered action fails at runtime') and must be its OWN declared edit, not buried in the new action's sketch. Declared here explicitly.
edits.sketch:
registry.go:1219 — new map entry:
    "feature_stage_route": {
        Handler:     FeatureStageRouteAction,
        Category:    "diagnose",
        Description: "Feature builder delta 2: deterministic stage-loop controller — walks a council-approved staged plan one stage per invocation ... refuses a pre-existing feat/* branch (E4)",
        IsLocal:     true,
    },
Registration by registry map key (not filename convention), so the documented filename-convention mistake is avoided.

edits.rationale: One seam: optional ref_field lets the stage router point stage N at the feat branch carrying stage N-1's commits. Round-1 bug_historian/guardian: the original resolve-or-fall-back shape silently read main on empty resolution — fixed fail-loud (9c94cc842). UNSET keeps the single-plan literal-ref path byte-identical.

Three seams for the stage loop: route the commit onto a given branch, a per-stage commit message, and enforce the stage's expected_symbols. Round-1 bug_historian [HIGH]: branch_field/commit_message_field silently falling back would commit a stage's files to the WRONG branch — fixed fail-loud (9c94cc842). expected_symbols false-reject mitigated at the designer source (edit 7), gate kept. All three UNSET keep the single-plan path byte-identical.

Opt-in go_test end-gate mode (E2): reuse the existing k8s Job machinery, packages DERIVED in Go from the plan's committed .go edits (never model-declared, D6). Round-1 bug_historian: an empty-resolved package list would silently degrade to a build-only gate, forfeiting D6 — fixed fail-loud (9c94cc842). UNSET keeps the build-only gate byte-identical.

One list entry so the dedicated feature-implementer pod receives the GITHUB_READ_TOKEN via the spawn gate, in the SAME read-token-only containment as fix-implementer (the 2026-07-13 lesson: an in-chassis implementer gets no token). Writes still go only via the git-adapter.
edits.sketch: spawn_actions.go:3030 — repoCloningAgents slice gains "feature-implementer" alongside "fix-implementer". isRepoCloningAgent(agentDef.Type) at the spawn site (line 2508) then injects the read token for the dedicated pod. Recurring failure point per the travelling NOTES (migration 184).

edits.rationale: The honest mitigation for editquality+guardian's expected_symbols false-reject: steer the DESIGNER never to name a symbol defined in another stage's file, rather than weaken the deterministic gate. Applied live (surgical jsonb_set on one leaf, snapshot ba8f1fcd) — a config_change, seed file PATCH_feature_designer_018 committed for provenance.
edits.sketch: PATCH_feature_designer_018: surgical replace() of design-step rule 8 only. Was: 'expected_symbols per stage: names ... that must literally appear in that stage's produced files'. Now adds: 'must literally appear in THIS stage's OWN produced files ... CRITICAL: list ONLY symbols this stage's edited files INTRODUCE. NEVER list a symbol your stage merely CALLS or references that is defined in an earlier stage's file ... a wiring-only stage uses an empty expected_symbols list.' Every other byte of the prompt and every other step untouched (jsonb_set on {workflow,steps,design,config,prompt_template} via replace()).

plan.risks: The seams sit on actions the LIVE fix-implementer shares, so the load-bearing guarantee is 'UNSET field => byte-identical single-plan path' — verified by the unchanged single-plan tests and by every new field being read only when its *_field config key is present (which the fix-implementer seed does not set). A reviewer should confirm: (a) no new field is read unconditionally; (b) the fail-loud errors cannot fire on the single-plan path (they are all guarded by the *_field key being non-empty); (c) the expected_symbols gate is unchanged and only the designer prompt moved (edit 7), so an already-approved plan is unaffected. The stage loop has now run in code review but NOT yet in a live multi-stage fire — the first implementer fire (RUNBOOK B4) remains the real test, and is expected to surface a defect as every first fire has.
